new_results.statement: For T=F(U)+2U^T C V+G(V) with independent original-coordinate blocks and cap-one coordinates, if s1(C)>=s2(C)>0 then P(T in K)<=e^(1/2)pi^(1/4)|K|^(1/2)(s1s2)^(-1/4), with arbitrary measurable within-bank terms F,G.
If H is symmetric zero-diagonal and s2(H)>tau, some coordinate cut C has s1(C)+s2(C)>tau/2; either s2(C)>=tau/16 with s1s2>7tau^2/256, or a near-rank-one diffuse/localized alternative occurs.

In the named-partner opposite-sign quantitative physical-pivot regime, a fixed lower bound on s2(S-diag S) yields a finite density bound via the new cut lemma plus the partner Hölder splice/fixed-s1 Schur-cross theorem.

local_refutation.statement: High s2(H) alone does not force a cut with quantitative s2(C): the target-class star matrix has spectrum {-1,2,2,3}, s2(H)=sqrt(3), and every cut cross block has rank one.

correction_compatibility: The new theorem uses only unconditional orthogonal projections of genuine independent cap-one blocks and of Z=U-U', whose coordinates remain independent cap-one. It does not use conditional spectral caps, bare 3D L-infinity coarea, normalized fragment/pair costs, or aggregate-O1-to-positive-pivot extraction.

unresolved_implication.quantifiers: Find universal m0, Delta0, tau0>0 and a finite set of already-paid alternatives so that every target matrix outside the spectral-window diffuse branch with s2(A-diag A)>3/10 either has a quantitative opposite-sign original-coordinate pivot with Schur residual s2(S-diag S)>tau0, or lies in a paid same-sign/majority-pivot/ridge/weighted-affine-fiber/grouped-bank branch. Because QFORM-O1-PIVOT-SCALE-FROM-MASS-FALSE-v1 is live, the grouped alternatives must explicitly include the singular/near-zero hyperbolic O1 packet rather than infer a positive pivot from O1 mass.

next_step: Attack the remaining high-offdiagonal structural extraction using an inverse-free O0/O1/O2/O3 overlap packet decomposition, retaining the singular hyperbolic O1 branch and arbitrary extra spectrum; do not select a reciprocal tiny minor.
